submission.body:
Refactored unit minting out of `src/decision/derive.ts` into `src/decision/mint.ts`, completing the three-part decomposition planned across group_b, group_a, and group_c:

- `src/decision/dependencies.ts` handles dependency validation (`readDependencies`) and the DFS cycle check (`findCycle`).
- `src/decision/units.ts` handles driver item parsing (`parseDriverItem`).
- `src/decision/mint.ts` handles unit minting (`mintUnits`, `finalizeMintedUnits`, `selectInputsForUnit`, `outputSlots`, `selectDriverArtifacts`, etc.), merging the two driver fanning loops into a single pass and validating uniqueness of unit IDs.
- `src/decision/derive.ts` retains purely the decision and derivation orchestration logic.

Verification:
- TypeScript typecheck (`tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`) passed cleanly with no errors.
- Test suite (`bun test`) passed all 29 tests.
